title: pr-pane 0.4.0: read base-branch rules; say why a PR is blocked and who can approve
summary: Show the base branch's review and check rules in the detail view, and enforce them in approve and merge.
description: The pane shows GitHub's verdict (needs review, blocked) but not why. Its only rule is the hardcoded author self-approval block. Requested by Jeremy via evolv-marketplace (Option A: evolvconsulting stays a free org, so private repos there expose no rules; evolvconsulting-prod is paid). Measured: rules/branches and branches/protection on private evolv-marketplace return 403 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro'; on public evolv-prs, rules/branches/dev returns [] and protection returns 404.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Rules come from GET rules/branches/{base} (pull_request: required_approving_review_count, require_code_owner_review, require_last_push_approval, dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push; required_status_checks), merged with GET branches/{base}/protection when it answers, and the line names which source answered
Rules are cached per repo and base branch for 10 minutes

The detail view shows a rules line: counts, CODEOWNERS, last-push and required checks with failing ones named; a 403 reads not readable (private repo on a free plan; GitHub enforces none), and a 404 or no rules reads none on <base>

Approve refuses when require_last_push_approval is on and the viewer authored or committed the head commit (stated as a heuristic), and warns when CODEOWNERS review is required and the viewer owns no changed path
The merge confirm lists the unmet rules instead of only No approving review
Tests cover 403, 404 and no rules, a ruleset with each parameter, the last-push refusal and the cache; validate --strict, plugin test and tsc pass

implementationNotes: API shapes measured before coding: evolv-marketplace (private, free org) rules/branches/dev -> 403 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro'; evolv-prs (public) rules/branches/dev -> [], branches/dev/protection -> 404 'Branch not protected'; pull_request and required_status_checks rule shapes from microsoft/vscode, anthropics/claude-code, facebook/react, astral-sh/uv, vercel/next.js; classic protection fields from the GitHub REST docs (require_code_owner_reviews, dismiss_stale_reviews). evolvconsulting-prod lists no repos to this token, so no paid-org repo was probed.

AC1/AC3/AC5: tests/rules.test.ts (11 tests: 403, 404, [] and deletion-only as none, 500 and bad JSON as error, every pull_request parameter, required checks, two pull_request rules combining, classic protection merge and source naming, approval counting, unmet rules replacing 'No approving review' without duplicating failing required checks).

AC2/AC4 (refusal half): tests/pane.test.ts mounts the pane, selects #7, finds the rules line, presses approve and finds the last-pusher refusal with no 'gh pr review' call; refresh within 10 min does not refetch, after 11 min it does. Mutation checks: disabling the TTL, disabling the refusal, or stamping rules as already stale each turn the suite 36/1.

AC4 left unchecked: the CODEOWNERS-ownership warning is unit-tested (approvalWarnings with viewerOwns false/true/null, codeownersOwners last-match, ownsAny with teams), but the register path that computes viewerOwns from the PR's files, the viewer and user/teams is not exercised by any test or live run.
Gates: 37/37, tsc 0 errors, validate --strict, lore check clean.
